pr_body:
# Objective

Reduce the nesting in UI examples through extraction.
Fixes #3850 

# Status

Testing which layouts scale better.
pr_comments:
Yeah, there is also a rare `insert` in between,

There is also the option of putting `Commands` into the functions,
but that reduces the layout readability.
It may be worth it if spaced well.

>  but this also shows how painful the whole parent.with_children is

Yep. My opinion is that this API should just be removed.

> What would replace it though?

`.push_children`, and the friends in #3855.
Gonna wait for a UI api refactor

issue_context.title: UI examples are deeply nested and not fun to read
issue_context.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?

UI examples could be more readable.

## What solution would you like?

Reduce the nesting by extracting instances creation to functions.
This will not only make the whole layout cleaner,
but naming the functions appropriately will help defining what certain components do.

## Additional context

I can do the PR just let me know whether this is desired.
comments:
The other pattern that I like is storing the entity id, and then using `.push_children`.

I'm in favor of this change though!

Yeah, there are many ways to go about it,
I'll experiment with few layouts in the PR,
I'm looking forward to feedback 😃
Closing as BSN already accomplishes this (when it lands)
And the new required components changes also help a lot!
